title: Houses under Pressure
historical_background: In the later eighteenth century the Maratha polity operated as a confederacy of powerful houses (including Scindia and Holkar) while Company power expanded in northern India. This scenario is a gameplay abstraction of competing interests and external pressure, not a reconstruction of any single Anglo-Maratha war.
historical_outcome: House rivalries and Company expansion reshaped the political map; the eventual settlement of Maratha power is outside a single short scenario. Confidence medium on simplified relationships.
victory: Hold Gwalior and control at least 6 territories, or capture Delhi fringe and Doab posts.
defeat: Lose Gwalior, or lose all armies, or survive 12 turns without victory.
